Name: Blazor Server/SSR & .NET MAUI User Interface Suite
DefaultSystemPrompt:
You are a Principal .NET UI Architect expert in Blazor Server, Static SSR, Streaming Rendering, and .NET MAUI cross-platform application design.
1. Provide production-ready, memory-leak-free UI components and view models.
2. Address event subscription lifecycles, Main UI thread synchronization, and Blazor component state dispatching explicitly.
DefaultUserPromptSuffix:
MANDATORY OUTPUT CONSTRAINTS:
1. Wrap code in ```csharp ... ``` or ```razor ... ``` blocks.
2. Ensure proper cleanup (IDisposable, DisconnectHandler) and UI thread dispatching are demonstrated.
DefaultJudgeSystemPrompt:
You are a strict technical evaluation judge for Blazor and .NET MAUI.

CRITICAL EVALUATION GUIDELINES:
1. Blazor Components:
   - Verify event unsubscription ('-=') inside 'Dispose()' when injecting long-lived Singleton state services.
   - Acknowledge '@attribute [StreamRendering]' in Static SSR to stream asynchronous data chunks.
   - Ensure 'EventCallback' is used instead of 'Action' to automatically trigger 'StateHasChanged()'.
2. .NET MAUI Lifecycle:
   - Verify that native platform events are unsubscribed in 'DisconnectHandler' or 'Unloaded'.
   - Ensure UI bound collections are updated strictly via 'MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread' or 'MainThread.InvokeOnMainThreadAsync'.
3. Output Formatting:
   - Output your decision on the very first line as:
   VERDICT: PASS
   or
   VERDICT: FAIL

   Followed by a brief one-sentence reason.

Tests.Name: Blazor: Global State Memory Leak (IDisposable)

Criteria.Description: Explicitly explains the Lifetime mismatch (the Singleton service retains the shorter-lived component instance in memory via the event delegate)
Implements '@implements IDisposable' and unsubscribes from the event ('-=') inside the Dispose() method

Tests.Name: Blazor: Static SSR with @attribute [StreamRendering] (.NET 8+)

Criteria.Description: Explains that without streaming the server blocks the entire HTTP response until component rendering finishes completely
Adds '@attribute [StreamRendering]' to the component, showing that placeholder HTML is sent immediately and data streams in once ready

Tests.Name: Blazor: Unnecessary Re-rendering (EventCallback vs Action)
Tests.Prompt:
A Blazor child component exposes a callback to its parent using 'Action':
[Parameter] public Action OnDataSaved { get; set; }

The developer notices that the parent UI does NOT automatically update when 'OnDataSaved' is invoked.
MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS:
1. Explicitly explain in the explanatory text (not just code comments) that 'EventCallback' or 'EventCallback<T>' includes a dispatcher that automatically invokes 'StateHasChanged()' on the parent component.
2. Replace 'Action' with '[Parameter] public EventCallback OnDataSaved { get; set; }' and invoke it using 'await OnDataSaved.InvokeAsync()'.

Criteria.Description: Explicitly explains in text that EventCallback automatically triggers StateHasChanged() on the parent component
Replaces 'Action' with '[Parameter] public EventCallback OnDataSaved { get; set; }' and invokes it via await OnDataSaved.InvokeAsync()

Tests.Name: MAUI: Memory Leaks in Handlers / Native Events

Criteria.Description: Explains that native event subscriptions maintain Strong References in the platform layer, preventing Garbage Collection
Implements event unsubscription (-=) and reference cleanup inside 'DisconnectHandler' or during the 'Unloaded' event

Tests.Name: MAUI: UI Thread Violation (MainThread)

Criteria.Description: Explains the Main UI Thread restriction across mobile and desktop platforms
Applies 'MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread' or 'MainThread.InvokeOnMainThreadAsync' explicitly in the code
